MEGA Game Night
Events/Mega Game Night

Mega Game Night

Date

Thu, Nov 5

Time

7:00 pm – 11:00 pm

Go all in for your community! Join us for an unforgettable night of games, food, and fun — all in support of the Miami Beach JCC. Test your luck and skill at Poker, Mah Jongg, Backgammon, and all your favorite casino games, from blackjack to roulette. Enjoy great food and an open bar throughout the night, all while helping raise MEGA funds for the programs and people that make the MBJCC community what it is. Because community is everything.

“The Casino gaming tables are provided for entertainment purposes only by Casino Party Nights Florida Inc., tel. 954-993-4739”. All Donations and proceeds go the (The Miami Beach JCC) *Must Be 18 Years or Older to Play*.

$75 per person
Includes Open Bar and Bites
(Gaming chips will be sold separately. More details provided upon registration.)

Game On! We look forward to seeing you at our MEGA Game Night fundraiser on November 5.

There will be many games to play, so to make sure we can accommodate everyone, please let us know what you’re up for playing. You are not committed to playing just one game all night. Have fun, play them all! Gaming Chips will be sold throughout the night and are needed to play all games.*

*Note: The Texas hold ’em Poker Tournament is a $500 Buy-In. Re-buys and Add-ons will be available. MEGA Cash prize, based on number of players
